name: Statue of Unity
scope: Complete exterior of the 182 m Sardar Patel sculpture and its intrinsic stepped geometric pedestal/entry shell: bald head and facial profile, jacket/shawl and dhoti folds, two walking legs with true gap, lowered hands, sandaled feet with toes, central upper support and original podium/entry outlines with actual openings and geometric lattice ramp. Exclude the separate mainland visitor buildings, the long river access bridges, island/river/hills/landscape, signs/flags/people, interior museum and mechanical cores.
era: Surviving completed monument; form from exact published 2019 and 2021 CC0 originals plus current native outline. Current cosmetic changes, hidden back and fine sculptural detail are bounded estimates.

references.caption: Probably the first ever photograph (lomograph) of the Statue taken on film. Also adapted an Alternative Photographic Process.

originalReview.notes: Whole exact published original individually inspected and native SHA1 matched. Named Veera.sj or Coolshaurya own work with explicit self CC0 dedication. Full body, bald head/profile, draped jacket and dhoti, asymmetrical walking legs, sandals and toes; intrinsic pedestal, entry and perforated geometric sloping panel visible. Film redscale and monochrome references govern form, not material color. No people, signs, flags, planted landscape or distant dam copied.
